name: POST /api/leadflow/sla/overnight-queue - acknowledge an out-of-hours arrival and commit to the next business morning
description:
Acknowledges an arrival outside business hours, captures a booking option, and commits to the next-business-day path (fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC1).

COVERAGE IS CHECKED BEFORE ANYTHING IS PROMISED (fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC3, fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC4). A same-night request routes to an approved on-call rep ONLY when sdk-coverage names one; otherwise the acknowledgement states the next-business-day commitment and offers a booking link instead. An UNREACHABLE roster is treated as NO coverage, deliberately: the failure modes are not symmetric, because assuming coverage during an outage promises a call nobody will make while assuming none merely sends a more conservative commitment. Verified live: a same-night request with no roster returned same_night_promised false with the reason stated.

THE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT RESPECTS THE RECIPIENT LOCAL QUIET HOURS (fe8a391f-f000-44aa-9f2a-ce108c98f951#AC2), not ours. Somebody who filled in a form at 23:00 their time should not be texted back because it is mid-morning in Chicago, so the constraint is handed to sdk-notification with quiet_hours_basis recipient_local rather than a window being computed here in the wrong timezone.

AN IN-HOURS ARRIVAL IS REFUSED 409 rather than queued. It is governed by the 30-minute SLA, and silently creating an overnight row would produce a next-day commitment for a lead that is due in half an hour. Verified live.

201 because a queue entry is a new addressable record. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: An in-hours arrival is refused, because the 30-minute SLA governs it
NEGATIVE: no lead_id, so there is nothing to acknowledge
NEGATIVE: an unparseable arrival instant is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: arrived_at must be a valid ISO timestamp
errorCases.when: the arrival instant cannot be parsed. The whole commitment is computed from it, so guessing would produce a due time for a moment nobody named.

errorCases.message: This arrival is inside business hours, so it is governed by the 30-minute SLA rather than the overnight path
errorCases.when: the arrival falls inside the workable window. Refused rather than queued: an overnight row would commit to the next morning for a lead due in 30 minutes.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
